about: A Navi chip of BN5's whose code moved into BN6's engine (issue #82's C3): BN5's CanladEX held paralysed (hold: each game's own status step, the same bits in both) at (5,2), MegaMan with a folder of one KnigtMn[SP] K and 29 Cannon A in both games, the KnigtMn[SP] dealt first (a Mega chip: a folder of them alone never deals), BN5's chip 255 by BN5's own code and the registry's 500 by the same code moved (BN5's Navi routine 0x05 as BN6's 0x22: its Navi's battle sprite the Navis' own, list 2's 0x20 on, its attack's objects the Navis' copies), the first Custom screen's chip picked and OK, used at t30: every difference of BN6's play from BN5's fails it (docs/MULTIROM.md, The chips' code). Its power BN5's computed one (0x0800E8D6, PowerSP moved): by the best deletion time of KnightMan's SP, none in BN5's save (0x02002670 all 0xFFFF) and none in BN6's engine (XC_SP_TIMES, src/emu/xchips_code.c): 220 in both.
